jnycam.notes: Ultra-wide: the Edge 60 Fusion's hidden 0.7x lens now works in Photo and Night (tap 0.7x, or pinch out from 1x). Crisper Smart photos at screen size: more mid-detail and local contrast, smoother walls and skies. Lab test (in the ⓘ report): tries the phone's own MediaTek switches — multi-frame noise reduction, HDR, remosaic 2x — and measures each.
